product_identity_field: Unique product URL from the supplied QC sheet; multiple SKUs under one URL count once
production_status: In progress in batches of 100. Only saved files count as generated.
source_policy: Reference assets were obtained only from the GitHub repository, including technical drawings and family photos. Missing, blank or unrelated references are explicitly discarded; images generated without adequate reference are unverified concepts and unusable until matched to the actual SKU. Sheet links identify target product specifications.
reference_policy_note: Per updated user request, missing references do not exclude products from the queue. Any image generated without an adequate reference must be identified as an unverified approximation unusable until matched against the actual product.
target_completed_definition: All selected new QC product URLs have generated files; this does not mean QC approval or distinct physical designs.
